headline: Approved July minutes, several vendor invoices, and heat plant roof replacement; discussed irrigation, clubhouse windows, and hole 18 drainage issues.
summary: The commission approved minutes and paid several vendor invoices for repairs including a water pump, dishwasher, sink hole repair, and plumbing work. Members discussed ongoing projects such as the Rennick Family clock, cart path patching, tennis court wind screens, a safety rail for the bridge between holes 8 and 9, and course water access for golfers. The commission also reviewed capital projects including clubhouse window renovation, golf course irrigation system upgrades estimated at $3 million, and hole 18 drainage concerns, and approved replacing the roof over the heat plant.
decisions: Approved the minutes of July 14, 2026, motion by Chad Crandall, seconded by Martin Lawler, carried 6-0.
Approved payment to ARC Mechanical for a new water pump for a cooling issue, motion by Arthur Athanas, seconded by Kevin Ascolillo, carried 6-0.
Approved payment to Summit Supply for dishwasher repair, motion by Arthur Athanas, seconded by Kevin Ascolillo, carried 6-0.
Approved payment to Amrize Hot Top Co. for repair of McKay Street due to a sink hole at the pump house area, motion by Arthur Athanas, seconded by Kevin Ascolillo and Paul Sciamanna, carried 6-0.
Approved payment to F.W. Webb Co., Drainpro/Spenseer for plumber support in clubhouse sink, motion by Arthur Athanas, seconded by Kevin Ascolillo, carried 6-0.
Approved replacement of the roof over the heat plant, motion by Arthur Athanas, seconded by Paul Sciamanna, carried 6-0.
